relationships.subject: hyodeoxycholic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: HDCA upregulated FXR expression and alleviated both mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: hyodeoxycholic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: HDCA treatment reversed the SNL-induced decrease in PPAR-γ levels and activation of MMP-9 and MMP-2

relationships.subject: hyodeoxycholic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: HDCA not only promoted PPAR-γ expression but also inhibited the activation of MMP-2 and MMP-9

relationships.subject: hyodeoxycholic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: HDCA treatment downregulated levels of NLRP3, IL-18, IL-6, TNF-α, and IL-1β at both mRNA and protein levels, all of which were upregulated by SNL

relationships.subject: FXR
relationships.evidence_quote: Fxr -/- mice showed a decreased baseline pain threshold compared with WT mice

relationships.subject: obeticholic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: INT-747 reactivated the expression of both FXR mRNA (Fig. 2E, F) and protein

key_findings: Neuropathic pain (SNL) lowers FXR in ileum and spinal cord and fecal HDCA; FXR knockout lowers pain threshold, while INT-747 or HDCA relieve pain.
HDCA restores intestinal barrier and microbiota, raises PPAR-gamma and suppresses MMP-9/MMP-2 and NLRP3-related cytokines in gut and spinal cord.
